title: Year 13 autumn mock: Paper 2
intro: Independent prior-topic revision only. This activity does not reproduce classroom assessment questions or marking schemes.

questions.prompt: What makes a program's output testable?
questions.answer: Defined success criteria and unambiguous rules.
options: Defined success criteria OR unambiguous rules.
There is not enough information to determine the result.
Defined success criteria and unambiguous rules.
questions.feedback: Model answer: Defined success criteria and unambiguous rules.

questions.answer: A requirement that must hold before an algorithm runs.
options: A requirement that need not hold before an algorithm runs.
A requirement that must hold before an algorithm runs.
A requirement that must hold after an algorithm runs.
questions.feedback: Model answer: A requirement that must hold before an algorithm runs.

questions.prompt: Which part of a partition is guaranteed to be in its final position?
questions.answer: The pivot (under the specified partition method).
options: The pivot (under the specified partition method).
There is not enough information to determine the result.
This result cannot be obtained using the stated method.
questions.feedback: Model answer: The pivot (under the specified partition method).

questions.prompt: Push 4,9,2 onto a stack; pop once; enqueue the popped value to queue [7,8], then dequeue. Give remaining stack and queue.
questions.answer: Stack bottom-to-top [4,9]; pop gives 2; queue [7,8,2] then dequeue 7 leaves [8,2].
options: Stack bottom-to-top [5,9]; pop gives 2; queue [7,8,2] then dequeue 7 leaves [8,2].
Stack bottom-to-top [3,9]; pop gives 2; queue [7,8,2] then dequeue 7 leaves [8,2].
Stack bottom-to-top [4,9]; pop gives 2; queue [7,8,2] then dequeue 7 leaves [8,2].
questions.feedback: Model answer: Stack bottom-to-top [4,9]; pop gives 2; queue [7,8,2] then dequeue 7 leaves [8,2].
